m1.typescript: m1 the plan resumes an unchanged session and tells a changed one what differs and starts fresh when most of it changed

e1.typescript: e1 changed deleted and added files are listed in order and any difference asks for a notice

e2.typescript: e2 more than half of the files changed or gone starts fresh and exactly half does not

e3.typescript: e3 a session idle for more than a week starts fresh and exactly a week is resumed

e4.typescript: e4 no saved session starts fresh and a fork is only planned from a session that is resumed

e5.typescript: e5 the change notice names only what differs and the prompt puts the notice or the summary before the task

e6.typescript: e6 the summary has a fixed layout with blank and repeated items dropped and files listed by path

e7.typescript: e7 options resume by id and fork together and continue is refused unless one session exists and a name must be unique

e8.typescript: e8 a run through the sdk passes resume and fork to the binary and returns the session id even after an error

wrong-ignores-changes.defect: resumes a session without a notice even when files changed

wrong-added-ignored.defect: does not count a new file as a difference

wrong-half-is-fresh.defect: starts fresh when exactly half of the files changed

wrong-added-counted.defect: counts new files toward the share of changed files

wrong-age-ignored.defect: resumes a session however long it has been idle

wrong-age-inclusive.defect: starts fresh when the session was idle for exactly a week

wrong-fork-without-session.defect: plans a fork even when the session is not resumed

wrong-notice-when-nothing.defect: writes a notice even when no file differs

wrong-summary-after-task.defect: puts the summary after the task

wrong-summary-keeps-repeats.defect: keeps repeated items in the summary

wrong-files-unsorted.defect: lists the files in the order they came

wrong-fork-alone.defect: sets the fork option even when there is no session to resume

wrong-continue-many.defect: continues the latest session when several exist

wrong-name-first-match.defect: resumes the first of several sessions that share a name

wrong-id-only-on-success.defect: reads the session id only from a successful result

wrong-no-fork-flag.defect: writes the fork option as false
